manifest.name: dsh-crawshrimp-scripts
manifest.description: Standalone DeepSeek Harness tools for portable Crawshrimp page scripts

scripts.check: node --check lib/errors.js && node --check lib/manifest.js && node --check lib/runtime.js && node --check lib/index.js && node --check examples/save-storage-state.js

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: crawshrimp-scripts
      name: dsh-crawshrimp-scripts
      config:
        adapterRoots: []
        workspaceDir: ~/.dsh-crawshrimp-scripts
        browserChannel: chrome
        storageStatePath: ''
        timeoutMs: 120000
        maxScriptBytes: 524288
        maxOutputBytes: 2097152

readme.text: This standalone repository is retired. All webpage work is maintained in [dsh-crawshrimp-browser](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser), including interactive page actions, explicit login state, portable scripts, parameter validation, pagination, live preview and manual takeover.

There is no standalone Scripts 0.2.0 release. Browser runs independently and does not depend on this package or the Crawshrimp backend. The original [v0.1.0 source and release](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-scripts/releases/tag/v0.1.0) remain available for history.

Copy your configured adapter roots, artifact workspace and private login-state path into the Browser row. Keep the old `workspaceDir` explicitly if you want to continue using previous artifacts. Then remove the old plugin and install Browser:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce remove -w dsh-crawshrimp-scripts
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser#v0.2.0
dsh --profile ecommerce --dump-config
```
Remove any custom `crawshrimp-scripts` row from your profile overlay. Configure the existing/new `crawshrimp-browser` row instead; do not keep both plugins loaded.

| Old tool/config | Browser equivalent |
| --- | --- |
| `crawshrimp_scripts_list` | `crawshrimp_browser_script_list` |
| `crawshrimp_scripts_run` | `crawshrimp_browser_script_run` |
| No offline validator | `crawshrimp_browser_script_validate` |
| `browserChannel` | `channel` |
| `timeoutMs` | `scriptTimeoutMs` |
| `adapterRoots`, `workspaceDir`, `storageStatePath`, `executablePath`, `cdpEndpoint` | Same explicit values |
| Default workspace `~/.dsh-crawshrimp-scripts` | `~/.dsh-crawshrimp-browser`, unless explicitly configured |

Update saved prompts/workflows to the new tool names. Existing artifacts and private login-state files are not moved or deleted automatically. See the [complete migration guide](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser/blob/v0.2.0/docs/migration-from-scripts.md) for the portable manifest subset and configuration details.

readme.section: Crawshrimp Scripts：已迁入浏览器插件
readme.text:
本独立仓库停止维护。所有网页相关能力统一由 [dsh-crawshrimp-browser](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser) 提供，包括页面操作、登录态、便携脚本、参数校验、翻页、实时预览和人工接管。

不会发布独立的 Scripts 0.2.0。浏览器包可以单独运行，不依赖本包或抓虾后端。原有 [v0.1.0 源码与 Release](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-scripts/releases/tag/v0.1.0) 保留供历史查阅。

先把 adapterRoots、workspaceDir、私有 storageStatePath 和浏览器配置迁入 `crawshrimp-browser` 配置行。如需继续使用旧产物目录，显式保留旧 workspaceDir。然后运行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce remove -w dsh-crawshrimp-scripts
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser#v0.2.0
dsh --profile ecommerce --dump-config
```

删除 profile overlay 中自定义的 `crawshrimp-scripts` 行，保留浏览器包配置，避免同时加载两包。

| 原工具/配置 | 浏览器包对应项 |
| --- | --- |
| `crawshrimp_scripts_list` | `crawshrimp_browser_script_list` |
| `crawshrimp_scripts_run` | `crawshrimp_browser_script_run` |
| 原无离线校验 | `crawshrimp_browser_script_validate` |
| `browserChannel` | `channel` |
| `timeoutMs` | `scriptTimeoutMs` |
| adapterRoots、workspaceDir、storageStatePath、executablePath、cdpEndpoint | 复制原显式值 |
| 默认目录 `~/.dsh-crawshrimp-scripts` | `~/.dsh-crawshrimp-browser`，可显式配置旧目录 |
旧产物和登录文件不会自动移动或删除；保存的提示词和工作流需要替换工具名。更多配置与脚本兼容范围见[完整迁移指南](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser/blob/v0.2.0/docs/migration-from-scripts.md)。
